d:
A massive celestial dragon with shimmering gold scales and a long, serpentine body. A crown of floating gold shards circles the head, and a flowing mane of stellar nebula energy runs down the spine. Two large, sweeping wings are composed of constellations and deep violet cosmic gas, ending in a long, tapering tail that trails stardust. Four claws on each paw.
BODY COLOR: shimmering gold
